KB-003 (refrigeration_unit, temperature drift) describes two possible scenarios: (1) controller's own reading stays at setpoint while cabin drifts above it -> sensor calibration drift causing under-cooling, fixed by diagnostic reset/self-calibration; (2) controller reading tracks the cabin probe upward together -> refrigeration circuit fault needing a technician. Observed telemetry matches scenario (1) clearly, since controller_reading_c never tracks the rising cabin_temp_c. No service history exists to suggest a chronic mechanical issue. Recommending diagnostic reset to re-run controller self-calibration.
